users._id: ObjectId - unique identifier for the user
users.name: string - full name of the user
users.email: string - email address used to log in
users.createdAt: Date - when the user account was created

households._id: ObjectId - unique identifier for the household
households.name: string - name of the household e.g. Sunset Apt 4B
households.address: string - physical address of the household
households.createdAt: Date - when the household was created

members.userID: ObjectId - reference to the user who is a member
members.role: string - role of the member e.g. admin or member
members.joinDate: Date - when the user joined the household
members.leaveDate: Date - when the user left, null if still active

expenses._id: ObjectId - unique identifier for the expense
expenses.householdID: ObjectId - reference to the household this expense belongs to
expenses.categoryID: ObjectId - reference to the category of this expense
expenses.paidByUserID: ObjectId - reference to the user who paid
expenses.title: string - name of the expense e.g. Rent, Groceries
expenses.totalAmount: number - total cost of the expense
expenses.datePaid: Date - when the expense was paid
expenses.notes: string - any additional notes about the expense

splits.userID: ObjectId - reference to the user who owes a share
splits.isPaid: boolean - true if this user has paid their share, false if not

settlements._id: ObjectId - unique identifier for the settlement
settlements.payerID: ObjectId - reference to the user who is paying
settlements.payeeID: ObjectId - reference to the user who is receiving payment
settlements.householdID: ObjectId - reference to the household this settlement belongs to
settlements.date: Date - when the settlement was made
settlements.notes: string - any additional notes about the settlement

categories._id: ObjectId - unique identifier for the category
categories.name: string - name of the category e.g. Rent, Utilities, Groceries
categories.description: string - description of what expenses belong in this category
